text: In Germany, Austria and Switzerland you usually pay at the table. When the waiter brings the bill, you say the total you want to pay including the tip: if the bill is 8,40 € you say Neun Euro or Stimmt so ("keep the change"). Do not leave the tip on the table. A tip of about five to ten percent is common, and nobody expects more.
Groups are often asked Zusammen oder getrennt?. Splitting the bill by item is normal, and the waiter will do it at the table.
